posts.title: Evacuate Yourselves
posts.description: On the night of 5–6 July 2026, Russia launched one of the largest attacks on Kyiv since the war began. I spent it in a hotel basement in Podil, following drone trajectories on one browser tab and a World Cup score on the other

posts.title: The Blurring
posts.description: What I live with isn't forgetting, it's the blurring. A meditation on grief, memory, and continuing without answers three years after loss.

posts.title: The Selection Effect: Exporting Burnout as Best Practice
posts.description: The tech industry has a selection problem: extreme work culture gets amplified globally while sustainable practices stay quiet. For those learning about Silicon Valley from a distance, this creates a dangerously distorted picture of what actually drives success.
